import sys

def process(totalCount, modulus):
    invs = []
    invs.append([1])
    for i in range(1, totalCount):
        prevInv = invs[i - 1]
        currentInv = [0] * (i * (i + 1) // 2 + 1)
        for j in range(len(currentInv)):
            sum_val = 0
            for k in range(min(j, i), -1, -1):
                if j - k < len(prevInv):
                    sum_val += prevInv[j - k]
                    sum_val %= modulus
            currentInv[j] = sum_val
        invs.append(currentInv)

    perms = [0] * totalCount
    perms[0] = 0
    for i in range(1, totalCount):
        c = (perms[i - 1] * (i + 1)) % modulus
        invArr = invs[i - 1]
        for j in range(len(invArr)):
            for k in range(j + 2, len(invArr)):
                mVal = min(k - j, i + 1)
                addVal = ((invArr[j] * invArr[k]) % modulus) * (((mVal - 1) * (2 * i - (mVal - 2))) // 2)
                c = (c + addVal) % modulus
        perms[i] = c
    print(perms[totalCount - 1])

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    totalCount = int(input_data[0])
    modulus = int(input_data[1])
    process(totalCount, modulus)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
